semiconductor_relevance: Medium — BKB Precision specializes in high-performance plastics machining, which is relevant for semiconductor manufacturing but does not directly supply semiconductor components.
summary: BKB Precision provides precision machining of high-performance plastics, catering to various high-tech sectors including semiconductor manufacturing. With over 40 years of experience, they offer services such as CNC machining, cleanroom assembly, and testing of plastic parts used in semiconductor applications.
